title: TodayWeather for Android · Forecast advertising
scenario: Version 2.0.0 preview. English controls and a saved Seoul forecast. Ads are embedded in the reading flow. The first Hourly and Daily visits each day are protected. At most one full-screen ad can appear across both tabs on eligible return visits that day.

steps.title: Hourly forecast
steps.instruction: Read the temperature and precipitation chart. Scroll past the hourly air-quality outlook if present.
steps.caption: The sample ad shows its image on the left and text on the right.
steps.expected: The compact card follows the chart and any hourly air-quality outlook.

steps.title: Daily forecast
steps.instruction: Open Daily and read the week at a glance. Scroll past the detailed-weather row to continue to the data source.
steps.caption: The sideways-scrolling dates and weather details sit above the compact sample ad.
steps.expected: The card appears above source attribution.

steps.title: Locations
steps.instruction: Open Locations and scroll beneath the saved places. Search and edit mode keep the list available for choosing a place.
steps.caption: The sample ad below Seoul uses a full-width card with its image above the description.
steps.expected: The card follows the saved locations while viewing the populated list.

steps.title: Air quality (AQI)
steps.instruction: Open Air and read the current grade and health advice. Follow the hourly outlook before continuing to detailed pollutant readings.
steps.caption: The sample ad shows its image beside the text, below the hourly AQI forecast.
steps.expected: The compact card comes before the detailed pollutant readings.
